mapper.insert: replace into ${database.prefix.userms}hou_base_article_group ( article_group_id, article_group_title, article_group_sort ) values(#{param.articleGroupId}, #{param.articleGroupTitle}, #{param.articleGroupSort})
mapper.select: select article_group_id, article_group_title,article_group_sort from ${database.prefix.userms}hou_base_article_group order by article_group_sort asc
select article_group_id, article_group_title from ${database.prefix.userms}hou_base_article_group where article_group_id = #{articleGroupId,jdbcType=INTEGER} order by article_group_sort desc
